description: Establishment of the Industry Transformation and Innovation Authority of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-29 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted on 2025-03-17 to amalgamate the Industrial Development Board, National Enterprise Development Authority and the Small Enterprise Development Division under the Ministry of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development and establish a more empowered single entity to provide industrial and enterprise development services in a more organized and efficient manner. Accordingly, the Ministry of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development has initiated the establishment of the Industry Transformation and Innovation Authority of Sri Lanka with the aim of minimizing duplication of work, strengthening the provision of institutional services, and building a national integrated platform for industrial transformation, entrepreneurship promotion and export-oriented enterprise development under a three-phase framework of conceptualization, strategic planning and implementation. For the purpose, steps are also being taken to obtain the necessary technical assistance under the Policy-Based Loan Programme of the Asian Development Bank. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development to pursue action with the draft Conceptual Framework for the proposed ‘Industry Transformation and Innovation Authority of Sri Lanka’, was approved by the Cabinet.
